questions.question: Factor x² + 5x + 6.
questions.explanation: 2 and 3 add up to 5 and multiply to 6. Expanding (x + 2)(x + 3) gives x² + 5x + 6.

questions.question: Factor x² − 9.
questions.explanation: This is a difference of two squares: x² − 3² = (x − 3)(x + 3). The middle terms cancel when expanded.
